notes: Reports (12 reasons, message excerpt by reporter), merged duplicates, one case per subject, priority/SLA queue, claim/assign/release. Reporter hidden in events/DTOs. Scans, no secondary indexes.
Append-only per-case SHA-256 hash chain (item hash covers prevHash); verifyEvidenceChain detects altered, gapped, relinked and truncated chains. Only hashes and refs stored.
One appeal per enforcement within 14 days; reviewer differs from decider/approver; upheld/overturned/modified; overturn reverses via SubjectActionsPort; full history kept.
dismiss/warn/remove_content/restrict/suspend/ban with policy clause and reason, strikes (180d decay, 3 -> recommendation), four-eyes for ban and minor safety, notify subject, expiry sweeper.
assessContent scores duplicate hashes across accounts, link density, posting velocity, new-account bursts (0..100, allow/review/block, reasons). Text never stored; each call is one attempt.
Private user blocks, BlockPort (bidirectional, O(1) index), capped at 1000; harassment pattern (>=3 distinct reporters in 7 days) escalates open cases about the account.
RiskPort: decayed signal total scaled by action sensitivity (low 0.6, standard 1, high 1.5); allow <40, challenge <75, deny; reasons list top signals. Amount is not yet used.
Signal store (7 kinds, default weights, override 1..100) with 30-day half-life decay, 300-day horizon and revocation by source (overturned decisions). System-write, staff-read.
RateLimitPort: persisted token bucket with exact integer refill arithmetic, per-prefix policy table, RATE.LIMITED with retryAfterMs. Properties: bound, exact retryAfter, determinism.
Tiers new (<7d) / established / trusted (>=90d, no strikes, low risk) with limits for listings/day, open offers, open trades, messages/hour, auction max value (USD cents, bigint).
